import sys

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
N = int(input[0])
M = int(input[1])
first_map = input[2:N+2]
second_map = input[N+2:]

for i in range(N - M + 1):
    for j in range(N - M + 1):
        if all(first_map[i + k][j:j + M] == second_map[k][j:j + M] for k in range(M)):
            print(i + 1, j + 1)
            exit()
